idea.title: The shop that sells a hundred brands
idea.one_line: A shop owner who stocks 100 plus brands is asked for his honest feedback on ours, on camera, with his own shelf behind him.
idea.why_it_works: He has a hundred alternatives on the wall and nothing to gain by being kind, so his opinion carries weight ours never could. And the asking is the whole tone: somebody who knows more is being consulted, not tested.
idea.who_for: Anyone who assumes a ₹49 tester means a cheap perfume

concept.where: a multi-brand perfume shop in a busy market, Ahmedabad
kit: 3ml testers, twenty of them, in a bag he can keep
Paper smelling strips, a dozen — never spray on his stock or his counter
Phone, and a collar mic if there is one; a market is loud
A small notebook to write his shop name and handle down correctly
concept.shoot_notes: Go at a dead hour, not when customers are in. Praise only what is actually true about the shop, and ask him on camera whether he wants it named and tagged — his shop being seen is the only thing he gets out of this, so give it to him properly. If he says no to the camera, buy something small and leave; there is another shop. And record long: you will keep the phone running for five to ten minutes of him talking and use about thirty seconds of it. Shots 5, 8 and 9 are all cut out of that one recording, so do not stop and restart between questions.

hook.spoken: 100 plus brand bechne wale se apna feedback lene aaya hoon.

people.who: the owner of the shop, who sells a hundred other brands
people.consent: Bhai, main SYNOR se hoon, apna perfume banata hoon. Ek video bana raha hoon aur aapka opinion lena chahta hoon. Jo sach mein lage wahi boliye, achha ho ya kharaab. Aapki dukaan ka naam bhi daal doonga. Theek hai?
people.disclosure: Maine unhe sirf testers diye, review unka apna hai.
questions: Sungh ke sabse pehle kya laga aapko
Aapke counter par is type ka kya chalta hai aaj kal
Ismein aapko kya kami lagti hai
Aapke hisaab se iski kimat kitni honi chahiye
Aap ise apne customer ko dena chahenge, ya nahi, aur kyun
listen_for: Whatever number he says when he guesses the price — that is the video, high or low
The word he reaches for first, before he has thought about it
Any comparison to what he stocks, so long as he says no brand name
A flat, bored or unimpressed answer — keep it in, it is worth more than a warm one
Whether he asks for testers himself, unprompted
Anything he says about the 30% oil once he has smelled it on skin
people.closing_if_warm: Bahar aa gaya. Sach kahun to andar jaate waqt thodi ghabrahat thi. Jo aadmi 100 plus brand bechta hai, unhone khud bola ki ______. Ye sun ke andar se shaanti mili. Aur tester bhi rakh liye unhone, maine kaha bhi nahi tha.
people.closing_if_cold: Bahar aa gaya. Sach bataun, jo socha tha wo nahi hua. Unhone kaha ki ______, aur baat galat bhi nahi hai. Sunne mein achha nahi laga, par isi liye to pucha tha. Agar main sirf tareef wale video daalunga to aap kabhi yakeen nahi karoge. Aap khud sungh ke batayiye.
people.why_them: Ye bhai din bhar perfume sunghte hain, 100 plus brand rozana bechte hain. Mujhe laga unka opinion sabse kaam ka hoga, mere se to zyada hi hoga.

thumbnail: His face mid-smell, strip at his nose, shelf blurred behind. Text: 100+ BRANDS, HIS FEEDBACK
diaries_tie_in: Becomes a Diaries entry on what somebody who sells perfume all day notices in the first four seconds, and what he does not care about at all.

lines: 100 plus brand bechne wale se apna feedback lene aaya hoon.
Mujhe laga jo itni saari brand rozana bechta hai, unka opinion sabse kaam ka hoga.
To chalo, try karte hain. Pata nahi haan bolenge ya nahi.
script.note: Three lines. The reason comes before the ask — that is the whole difference between this and walking in to test somebody.

script.scene: Inside, at the counter — the asking
script.camera: low, not on his face yet
lines: Namaste bhai.

Bhai, main SYNOR se hoon, apna perfume banata hoon. Ek video bana raha hoon aur aapka opinion lena chahta hoon. Jo sach mein lage wahi boliye, achha ho ya kharaab. Aapki dukaan ka naam bhi daal doonga. Theek hai?
Do minute lagenge bhai, bas itna hi.
script.their_turn: Yes or no. Only go on after a yes — a no means buy something small and leave, there is another shop.
script.note: Give him an easy way out. A line that makes refusing awkward buys a dishonest yes, and a dishonest yes is visible on camera.

script.camera: panning the shelf, no single label held in frame
lines: Bhai aapki dukaan kitne saal se hai?
100 plus brand rakhte ho aap, sahi hai na?
Ye bhai din bhar perfume sunghte hain, 100 plus brand rozana bechte hain. Mujhe laga unka opinion sabse kaam ka hoga, mere se to zyada hi hoga.
Mujhe to apne hi perfume ki aadat pad gayi hai, ab mujhe farak hi nahi pata chalta.
script.their_turn: How old the shop is, how many brands he carries.
script.note: The third line is said to camera while he is busy, or as voice-over in the edit. The fourth is the one that puts him above you, and it happens to be true.

lines: Ye dekhiye. SYNOR Ocean Verve. Tees percent oil hai ismein.
Strip pe daal raha hoon, aapke stock pe nahi.
Sungh ke sabse pehle kya laga aapko?
script.their_turn: His first reaction, unprompted. This is shot 5.
script.note: The line about not spraying his stock matters more than it looks — he is guarding his shelf until he hears it.

script.camera: the strips, him holding all three
lines: Ye SYNOR Royal Oud hai. Sardi ke liye banaya hai.
Aur ye SYNOR Velvet Heels, ladies ke liye.
Aapke counter par is type ka kya chalta hai aaj kal?
script.their_turn: What sells at his counter now. Let him talk about his own shop; he is more open about ours afterwards.

script.camera: his face, still, no cutting away
lines: Bhai ek baat sach batayiye. Ismein aapko kya kami lagti hai?
Nahi bhai, khul ke boliye. Tareef to sab kar dete hain, mujhe kami janni hai.
Aapke hisaab se iski kimat kitni honi chahiye?
Aur aap ise apne customer ko dena chahenge, ya nahi? Kyun?
script.their_turn: The criticism (shot 9), the price guess (shot 8), and whether he would stock it.
script.note: Ask the second line only if the first gets 'sab achha hai'. Once. A third time is fishing, and the camera shows it.

script.camera: the counter, the bag, his hand
lines: Bhai, ye bees tester chhod raha hoon aapke paas. Customer ko sungha dijiye, koi paisa nahi.
Ek baat bata doon. Maine unhe sirf testers diye, review unka apna hai.
script.their_turn: He may ask how many he can have. If he asks first, that is the better ending — use it.
script.note: The second line stays in the cut. Not optional.

script.camera: selfie, the shop over your shoulder
lines: Sabko pasand nahi aayega, Royal Oud bahut bhaari hai.
Tester sirf ₹49, aur wahi ₹49 bottle par wapas.
script.note: Which closing you speak depends on what he said; both are below. Film it while still outside his shop, before the feeling wears off.
